metadata.technology_reasoning: The dilution refrigerator-based superconducting quantum computer is the most established and widely adopted form of quantum computing hardware as of 2024 due to its ability to achieve millikelvin temperatures required for superconducting qubits to operate with coherence times suitable for quantum computation. This technology dominates the commercial and research quantum computing sector with market leaders like IBM, Google, and Rigetti employing this architecture.
